SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN
  p.proowner = (SELECT relowner FROM pg_catalog.pg_class WHERE oid = 'private.helix_environment'::pg_catalog.regclass)
  AND p.proowner <> current_user::pg_catalog.regrole AND NOT p.prosecdef
  AND p.prolang = (SELECT oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_language WHERE lanname = 'sql')
  AND p.prokind = 'f' AND p.provolatile = 's' AND NOT p.proretset AND p.prorettype = 'boolean'::pg_catalog.regtype
  AND p.proconfig = ARRAY['search_path=pg_catalog, pg_temp']
  AND pg_catalog.encode(pg_catalog.sha256(pg_catalog.convert_to(p.prosrc,'UTF8')),'hex') = '1320b6b730d4def795f6bd691914782eefcbf10bb376c767bd8661bc034eae9c'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(p.proacl) a WHERE a.grantee = current_user::pg_catalog.regrole
    AND a.grantor = p.proowner AND a.privilege_type = 'EXECUTE' AND NOT a.is_grantable)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_catalog.aclexplode(p.proacl) a WHERE a.grantee <> p.proowner
    AND (a.grantee <> current_user::pg_catalog.regrole OR a.grantor <> p.proowner OR a.is_grantable))
  THEN private.live_checkout_contract_installed() ELSE false END
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc p WHERE p.oid = pg_catalog.to_regprocedure('private.live_checkout_contract_installed()')), false) AS applied
